senses.gloss: f. (χαλκίς, -ίδος) chalkis, a small fish resembling sardines (v. Sm. Ant. s. v.).
units: Y. Ned. VI, 39ᶜ bot. if one says, I will taste no דָּגָה, אינו … אלא בכ׳ he is forbidden ony ch. (small fish). Ib.ᵈ top כיל׳ אנא טעים I feel as if I were eating ch.—

Ib. לית … והוא זבין ליה כ׳ is it not often the case when a man says to his neighbor, buy me a fish, that he will buy ch. for him?—Y. Erub. III, 20ᵈ top כלבודא (corr. acc.); Y. Peah VIII, 21ᵃ top (סלק׳) כלקורא, read: כַּלְקִידָא.
